The name signifies the gentle and soothing sensation of raindrops, as well as the freshness and renewal it brings to the earth. The name Adr carries the meaning “Light Rain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Adr usually hope their child will grow to embody light rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
